# Christmas Escape Room

> Christmas Escape Room (christmasescaperoom.co.uk) is a free UK website of Christmas escape room games to play online or print at home, plus free puzzle tools.

## Games
- [The Missing Sleigh Key](https://christmasescaperoom.co.uk/play-online/the-missing-sleigh-key/): free online Christmas escape room, 5 puzzles, 20–30 minutes, ages 8+, no download.
- [The Great Pudding Heist](https://christmasescaperoom.co.uk/printable/the-great-pudding-heist/): free printable Christmas escape room, 5 clue cards, 30–45 minutes, ages 6+.

- [Christmas Eve escape room](https://christmasescaperoom.co.uk/printable/christmas-eve/): printable bedtime game, ages 5–10, 20–30 minutes.
- [Boxing Day escape room](https://christmasescaperoom.co.uk/printable/boxing-day/): printable family game, ages 8+, 30–45 minutes.
- [New Year's Eve escape room](https://christmasescaperoom.co.uk/printable/new-years-eve/): printable countdown game, ages 10+, 30–45 minutes.
- [KS2 Christmas escape room](https://christmasescaperoom.co.uk/printable/ks2-classroom/): classroom game for Years 3–6, 45–60 minutes.
- [10-minute Christmas escape room](https://christmasescaperoom.co.uk/play-online/ten-minute-christmas-escape-room/): 3 quick online puzzles.
- [Christmas escape room without a printer](https://christmasescaperoom.co.uk/play-online/no-printer-christmas-escape-room/)
- [Scrooge's Safe](https://christmasescaperoom.co.uk/printable/scrooges-safe/): adults. [Elf Academy Final Exam](https://christmasescaperoom.co.uk/printable/elf-academy-final-exam/): teens. [Rudolph's Lost Bells](https://christmasescaperoom.co.uk/printable/rudolphs-lost-bells/): ages 3–5. [Christmas Memory Lane](https://christmasescaperoom.co.uk/printable/christmas-memory-lane/): care homes. [Office Party Escape](https://christmasescaperoom.co.uk/play-online/office-party-escape/): work teams. [Advent calendar](https://christmasescaperoom.co.uk/printable/advent-calendar/).

- [Reindeer Rescue: Team Race](https://christmasescaperoom.co.uk/play-online/reindeer-team-race/): free Christmas team game for Microsoft Teams, Zoom and offices; unlimited teams with a free leaderboard.

## Tools
- [Christmas escape room builder](https://christmasescaperoom.co.uk/tools/escape-room-builder/): make a custom printable escape room by age and hiding places.
- [Christmas cipher maker](https://christmasescaperoom.co.uk/tools/christmas-cipher-maker/): pigpen, Caesar and number codes with printable key.
- [Escape room timer](https://christmasescaperoom.co.uk/tools/escape-room-timer/): countdown with hint counter.
- [Certificate maker](https://christmasescaperoom.co.uk/tools/certificate-maker/): printable 'You saved Christmas!' certificate.

## Guides
- [How to make a Christmas escape room at home](https://christmasescaperoom.co.uk/how-to/make-a-christmas-escape-room/)
